topics.topic: Whether metadata removal must also be guaranteed for images delivered through the Portal client-download path
questions: Does the metadata guarantee end at the binary store, or must the image delivered through the Portal's client-download path also contain no EXIF, GPS, XMP or comment?

precedent.topic: Owner and caller of scan, deliver, and record-publication flows
quotes:
The calling agent is outside this service and organises the work (R0-15). It reads and publishes in the Portal with
its own session. It reaches the deliverer only through the routes of `module:deliverer_router`, which check the
token with `module:deliverer_api` and delegate to `module:photo_delivery`. The deliverer never calls the Portal. Showing a photo to the client is a later
action of the owner in the Portal and is not part of this flow.
precedent.why: State 4 defines owner_delivery as an externally executed calling-agent flow that composes the service routes and Portal operations, not as a deliverer-service capability.
